{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3

|version1= 2.04

|branch= diag

|gr1= Diagnostic

|descr= Returns the terrain segment. It is basically the same as:
<sqf>
_worldPos params ["_x", "_y"];
[floor (_x / diag_getTerrainGrid), floor (_y / diag_getTerrainGrid)];
</sqf>

|s1= [[diag_getTerrainSegmentOffset]]  worldPos

|p1= worldPos: [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position3D]] - world coordinates

|r1= [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] - [x,y] of terrain segment (integer, basically pixel coordinates in heightmap)

|x1= <sqf>private _segmentOffset = diag_getTerrainSegmentOffset getPosWorld player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[diag_getTerrainHeight]] [[diag_getTerrainGrid]]
}}
